status: Post-exposure and reference-exposed exploratory measurement; image, catalogue dimensions and candidate comparison had already been inspected.
question: Can Fr 10370's own image support a visible writing span wider than the published II.64 catalogue width of 18.5 cm?
measurement: Difference between interior points on the same visible line divided by horizontal ruler pixels per centimetre. It is an image-based lower bound on the apparent line span, not a full written-area measurement.
sensitivity: Independently allow each glyph x coordinate to move up to 20 pixels inward and each ruler mark up to 4 pixels outward. These are illustrative selections, not measured error bounds; they do not account for perspective or curvature.
limitations: Unknown ruler and parchment plane relationship
II.64 measurement and exact heading leaf not independently checked
Different leaves in a composite book may have different dimensions
